The intelligence-to-action workflow

Maintain once. Keep current. Cascade intelligently.

Intelligence confidence methodology

No opaque black-box rating. Each dimension is explainable and traceable to evidence.

01 / FACTObserved information

Records, filings and sourced reporting with dates and provenance.

02 / HYPOTHESISAnalyst interpretation

Reasoned conclusions with confidence and alternative explanations.

03 / VERIFIEDCorroborated evidence

Documents and independent checks supporting the assessment.
